_notes: Accessibility statement (P2 #12). Target WCAG 2.2 AA, followed voluntarily; 'updated' is the date this statement was last revised.

seo.title: Accessibility statement | RNC Landscaping
seo.description: RNC Landscaping follows WCAG 2.2 Level AA on this website voluntarily. What we have done, known limits, and how to report a problem or ask for another format.

lede: We want everyone to be able to use this website, including people who use a screen reader, keyboard, magnification or voice control.

sections.heading: Our standard
body: We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at Level AA across this website.

The [Accessible British Columbia Act](https://www.bclaws.gov.bc.ca/civix/document/id/complete/statreg/21019) sets accessibility duties for prescribed organizations. A small private business like ours is not prescribed under it, so we follow WCAG 2.2 AA voluntarily.

items.title: Contrast
items.body: Text, controls and focus outlines meet AA contrast in light and dark appearance.

items.title: Keyboard
items.body: Menus, the quote form and the before-and-after comparison work with a keyboard, with a visible focus outline that is not hidden by the sticky header or action bar.

items.title: Forms
items.body: Every field has a label, help text and error messages linked to the field. Entered values are never cleared.

items.title: Images
items.body: Meaningful images have hand-written text alternatives; decorative images are hidden from screen readers.

items.title: Motion
items.body: Animation is short and turned off when you choose reduced motion. There are no carousels, autoplay or loading screens.

items.title: Zoom and reflow
items.body: Pages reflow at 320 px wide and work at 200% zoom without sideways scrolling.

sections.heading: Known limits
body: Some linked government pages and PDF documents are outside our control and may not meet the same standard. Photos labelled Sample image are placeholders until RNC supplies its own.

sections.heading: Report a problem or ask for another format
body: If something doesn't work for you, contact us at [EMAIL] or [PHONE]. Tell us the page and what happened. We reply within [REPLY TIME] and will fix the problem or give you the information another way.
